description: Full-budget psmnist BRF reproduction and paired graded-emission comparison. Four arms, five seeds; original architecture and training budget; select by fixed held-out validation loss. Scheduler shard: graded_static, all five seeds. Kaya H100 allocation; the experiment recipe is unchanged.
decision_rule: Require an explained BRF reproduction before interpreting alternatives. Report every seed, paired differences, event rate, payload scale and failures; no checkpoint selection from test accuracy.

cost.estimate_basis: Original update budget times second-epoch H100 qualification batch median, plus 15% for validation/setup.
